Chapter 806: Chapter 18 Taiyang Divine Master And Taiyin Sovereign (8000 Words, Chapter Two In One)

Chapter 806: Chapter 18 Taiyang Divine Master and Taiyin Sovereign (8000 words, chapter two in one)

“They’re really quick at escaping.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the nineteen Demonic Divine Masters, who were frantically fleeing into the distance.

He wasn’t too concerned.

Most of his attention was focused on the three Void Creatures inside the cage in his right palm.

More precisely, on the Void Creature Monarch whose body was shimmering with gold.

The other two Void Creatures didn’t restrain Lin Yuan’s power much.

...

It was mainly that Void Creature Monarch.

This Void Creature Monarch was extremely powerful, far surpassing ordinary Demonic Divine Masters.

Had Lin Yuan not arrived in time, and had nearly twenty masters such as the Heavenly Python Divine Master and the Eight-Handed Lord, who depended on their numerical advantage, entered the Void Creature Nest,

it is likely they would have been entirely obliterated.

This Void Creature Monarch was entirely concealing its strength.

Presenting a false appearance to those nineteen Demonic Divine Masters that it could be dealt with.

Just waiting for the Demonic Divine Masters to come in, to capture them all in one sweep.

The Heavenly Python Divine Master and other Demons thought themselves the hunters, little knowing they had already become the prey of the Void Creatures.

After Lin Yuan’s appearance, this Void Creature Monarch faintly felt that something was awry.

So it wanted to flee ahead of time.

As a result, Lin Yuan took action directly, and his third claw dragged it out.

That’s also why Lin Yuan didn’t bother with those nineteen Demonic Divine Masters.

A slight delay might have allowed this Void Creature Monarch to escape.

“Interesting.”

“Not low in wisdom, either.”

Lin Yuan examined the Void Creature Monarch in his palm with interest.

From the outside, this Void Creature Monarch looked weak, tightly bound within Lin Yuan’s palm.

But from the perspective of this Monarch, it was in the midst of a vast and limitless void, like a slightly smaller version of the Void Secret Realm, immensely vast.

Any attacks or struggles from the Void Creature Monarch could not break free from this colossal void.

After reaching the Five-Layered Realm of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules, Lin Yuan can, if he so wishes, temporarily condense a relatively complete space-time.

This was also one of the means for him to completely rid himself of the constraints of the River of Time when striking for the ultimate at the Eleventh Rank Peak.

“It’s about time.”

Moments later, the power of space-time turned into the power of oblivion.

The two Void Creatures next to the Void Creature Monarch rapidly dissipated into nothingness, and lastly, the golden Void Creature Monarch also began to disintegrate.

“Ah… how comfortable…”

Killing a Void Creature of the Ninth Stage brought about a significant increase in Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will.

Having continuously killed eight Ninth Stage Void Creatures, Lin Yuan’s overall increase in Spirit Will had grown by at least twenty percent.

That is to say, his original Spirit Will Index of ten million points has now increased to at least twelve million points.

A significant increase, but within Lin Yuan’s expectations.

However,

when that golden Void Creature Monarch died, the power it turned into doubled Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will Index almost instantly.

Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will Index shot up to twenty million points.

You must know, the higher the Spirit Will Index, the more difficult it is to improve. Going from ten million to twelve million points,

compared to going from twelve million to fourteen million points, although both are an increase of two million points,

the difficulty is entirely different.

Let alone Lin Yuan’s increase from twelve million straight to twenty million points.

This shows how formidable the golden Void Creature Monarch was; the stronger the Void Creature killed, the higher the surge in Spirit Will strength.

“A Spirit Will Index of twenty million points, even in the Main Universe, would be rare among those below the Twelfth Rank, wouldn’t it? Even those special beings born with the opening of the universe and surviving until now, their Spirit Will Indexes are probably just over ten million, as for twenty million?”

“Difficult, difficult, difficult!”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

Without the endless Void Creatures of the Void Secret Realm, it’s uncertain how long it would have taken for his Spirit Will to reach its current level.

According to the classification of the Spirit Will by the Ten Thousand Universe Races’ Powerhouses, a Spirit Will Index of eighteen million points is the limit for Tier 11 life.

Exceeding eighteen million points, it enters the Twelfth Rank domain.

It is a height only Supreme Beings can reach.

Supreme Beings who have escaped the River of Time, had their Spirit Will honed by the ‘shore’ aura, far exceeding eighteen million points.

“Unexpectedly, the first ability of mine to reach the threshold of the Twelfth Rank Level is the Spirit Will?”

Lin Yuan felt a sense of emotion in his heart. Before undertaking the tenth traversal, he had always thought it would be the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

With the comprehension of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule by the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, coupled with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, even if he didn’t reach the Sixth Realm this time, when he returned, there was a great hope of crossing into it.

If it wasn’t for the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules, then it would be another Pillar-level Fusion Rule.

During his journey to the Two-dimensional World, Lin Yuan became the final winner and gained everything from the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, not just the Understanding of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, but also many other Fusion Rule comprehendings.

The Understanding of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule was just refined and easily absorbed by the ‘White Paper’ senior.

Besides the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, Lin Yuan’s Life and Death Samsara Rule, Great Destruction Rule, and other Pillar-level Fusion Rules had reached the Sixth Realm.

Generally speaking, the Seventh Realm is the domain that only Supreme Beings can comprehend for such Pillar-level Fusion Rules.
